name: M42 acceptance gate
note: These targets were fixed BEFORE any M42 training run. They are not to be changed after a candidate has been evaluated. A candidate that misses any 'required' item is not deployed: M40 stays the default and the gap is reported.

evaluation.gate_set: test_all = ai_training/data/manifests_m40/test.jsonl, unchanged (byte-identical copy in the candidate's manifests)
evaluation.gate_input: detector crop: whole photo -> garment detector -> tight box + 10 % margin -> classifier (whole photo when no box). This is what the app does.
reported_separately_not_gated: test_dmm (same source as part of the training data)
evaluation.selection: The checkpoint (best validation mean macro-F1) and every confidence threshold are chosen on the validation split only. The test sets are used once, after selection.

auto_answer.rule: A head is answered automatically only above its validation-chosen threshold. Every head the candidate answers automatically must be at least 90 % correct when it answers, on test_all with the detector crop. A head that misses this is a gate failure (it may not simply be switched off after seeing the test result).
auto_answer.validation_rule: A head may be answered automatically only if every one of its classes has at least 15 trusted validation examples; otherwise validation cannot reveal a failure on that class and the head stays 'please select'. Thresholds are chosen on validation with the app's detector crop: the smallest score at which accepted validation predictions are >= 90 % correct with >= 20 % coverage.

integrity: the candidate loads in the production inference code with heads 3 / 5 / 3 / 4
the test files used are byte-identical to the M40 test files
no training photo is identical or near-identical (dHash <= 4) to a test photo

new_classes.rule: Not part of the pass / fail decision. A new class is offered as an AI suggestion only if it has at least 30 human-reviewed test examples and reaches F1 0.60 on them; otherwise the app keeps showing 'please select' for it and the report says so.

decision.pass: every 'required' item holds -> the candidate becomes the default model; M40 (checkpoint + thresholds sidecar) is kept as the rollback
decision.fail: any 'required' item fails -> M40 stays the default; the report lists each failed item with the measured value and the target
